why: POLICY-DRIFT (2026-08-28): data/nva-offers.json is GENERATED from Microsoft's built-in MANA NVA policy, so a new policy version is exactly the kind of upstream change that invalidates local data with nothing in our code moving - the same class UPST-1 watches for scripts and UPST-3 for docs. Built-in policies are published in this public repo, so the check needs no Azure auth and no token, like the other two watchers. Fetched anonymously on purpose: an authenticated token bound to another org's SAML gets 403 here.

policies.name: MANAExistingVMNVASupport_Modify.json
localDerivatives: src/VmMigrationFactory/data/nva-offers.json (REGENERATE from the new definition, never hand-edit)
